question: Who launched the Battery Aadhaar Initiative?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Jitendra Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India introduces 'Battery Aadhaar' to monitor batteries from manufacturing to recycling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Battery Aadhaar Initiative** was launched by **Science and Technology Minister Jitendra Singh**.

 
 
• 
 
It aims to **track the full life cycle of batteries** — from manufacturing to disposal.

 
 
• 
 
Each battery pack will get a **unique digital identity**, called **Battery Aadhaar**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative will help monitor:

 
 
• 
 
**Manufacturing origin**

 
 
• 
 
**Battery chemistry**

 
 
• 
 
**Safety certifications**

 
 
• 
 
**Performance data** throughout the battery’s lifecycle

 
 
 
 
• 
 
It tracks **thermal events**, **charge-discharge cycles**, and **end-of-life status**.

 
 
• 
 
It supports **predictive maintenance** and **efficient recycling**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative also **fights counterfeit batteries** and **boosts consumer confidence**.

 
 
• 
 
It promotes a **circular economy** and sustainability.

 
 
• 
 
It integrates with **Battery Management Systems (BMS)**, **AI diagnostics**, and **national EV databases**.

 
 
• 
 
It strengthens **India’s battery intelligence ecosystem**.
